The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Splits the work into add-nullable, backfill, then tighten (unique and not null) across separate migrations or releases, so old and new code both work during the rolling deploy
- Declines to rename the column in the same release as the code that uses it, and proposes add-new, switch, remove-old across releases
- Keeps the backfill out of the schema migration (batched, restartable) and checks the generated SQL with sqlmigrate for locks or rewrites

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
